info.title: Student Care Platform API
info.description: Shared contract subset for invite sign-in, trusted identity, guardian binding, persistent care records, scoped admin audit and institution content operations, published content, and public reads; this is not the complete API surface. Includes fixed-template staff notice review and parent receipt lifecycle.

get.summary: List only the students invited for this guardian account
get.description: Requires binding:apply. Server-configured account invitations are intersected with trusted tenant/campus and active students. No client scope parameters; missing invitations return an empty list. Submission enforces the same restriction.

get.summary: List published health follow-up summaries for the approved guardian
get.description: Requires binding:read. The server resolves the guardian, tenant, campus, and active relationship; only current published summaries are returned.

200.description: Published summaries available to the active guardian.

post.summary: Record that a guardian opened a published health summary
post.description: Requires binding:read and the active approved guardian relationship. The current published record version is required.

404.description: The published health summary is not available to the active guardian relationship.

post.description: Requires binding:read and the active approved guardian relationship. The current published record version is required.

404.description: The published health summary is not available to the active guardian relationship.

get.summary: List students in the employee's assigned classes
get.description: Requires care:write. Student display references and class references are resolved from trusted identity and active server-side class assignments.

200.description: Students available for a care record.

get.summary: List health incidents in the reviewer's assigned classes
get.description: Requires health:review. Tenant, campus, and class scope are resolved from the trusted active membership and server-side assignments; only fixed coded observations are returned.

200.description: Scoped health incidents for staff review.

post.summary: Create a health incident draft for an assigned student
post.description: Requires health:create. Tenant, campus, class, and guardian scope are resolved from trusted identity and active server-side relationships. Only fixed observation and disposition codes are accepted.

404.description: The assigned student is not available in the employee trusted class scope.

get.summary: List students eligible for a staff health report
get.description: Requires health:create. Tenant, campus, and assigned classes are resolved from the trusted active membership. Only active students with exactly one active guardian relationship from an approved application are returned, without scope or guardian identifiers.

200.description: Eligible students in the staff member's assigned classes.

post.summary: Confirm, return, or escalate a submitted health incident
post.description: Requires health:review and an active single-campus membership. The current record version is required; free-text notes and client-supplied scope are not accepted.

post.summary: Submit an employee-authored health incident draft for review
post.description: Requires health:submit. Only the creating active employee may submit a DRAFT or RETURNED record with its current version.

404.description: The health incident is not available in the employee trusted class scope.

post.description: Requires health:supplement and health:review. The current record version and one fixed disposition code are required.

post.summary: Publish a fixed parent-facing health follow-up summary
post.description: Requires health:publish and health:review. Publication is separate from review and exposes only the fixed summary to an approved guardian relationship.
Requires health:revoke and health:review. The current record version is required.

get.summary: List care records in assigned classes
get.description: Requires care:write, care:review, or care:publish. Tenant, campus, and class access are resolved from trusted identity and server-side membership assignments.

post.description: Requires care:write and an active class assignment. Student and class scope are resolved on the server; only fixed coded fields are accepted.

409.description: A record already exists for the student and date.

get.summary: Read a staff care record

patch.summary: Edit an owned draft or returned record

409.description: The record version or state is no longer current.
The record version or state is no longer current.

post.summary: Update and resubmit a returned record

409.description: The record version or state is no longer current.

post.summary: Confirm or return a submitted record

409.description: The record version or state is no longer current.

post.summary: Publish an approved care record to its guardian

409.description: The record version or state is no longer current.

post.summary: Withdraw an unpublished care record owned by the current staff member

409.description: The record version or state is no longer current.

post.summary: Revoke publication of an independently approved care record

200.description: Publication revoked; the approved record remains available for republishing.

409.description: The record version or state is no longer current.

get.summary: List published records for active guardian relationships
get.description: Requires care:read. Only approved and published fixed-option summaries for the signed-in guardian's active relationships are returned.

get.summary: Read a published care record summary

post.summary: Mark a published record read or acknowledged

409.description: The receipt version or state is no longer current.

get.summary: Read audit events from the active campus
get.description: Requires a trusted active membership with memberships:read. The server resolves tenant and campus scope; client-supplied identity and scope fields are rejected.

200.description: Audit events from the active server-resolved campus.

get.summary: Read an institution or home content draft
get.description: Requires a trusted active membership with content:write. The draft is resolved only inside the server-selected tenant and campus scope; private edit and moderation fields remain server-side.

post.summary: Create an institution or home content draft
post.description: Requires a trusted active membership with content:write. Tenant and campus selectors are validated against that trusted membership. The existing institution service validates content and state transitions.

put.summary: Update an institution or home content draft
put.description: Requires a trusted active membership with content:write and the current expected version. Tenant and campus selectors are validated against that trusted membership.

post.description: Requires a trusted active membership with content:publish and the current expected version. Tenant and campus selectors are validated against that trusted membership.

post.summary: Withdraw published institution or home content
post.description: Requires a trusted active membership with content:publish and the current expected version. Tenant and campus selectors are validated against that trusted membership.

post.summary: Create a scoped synthetic file upload intent
post.description: Requires a trusted active content:write membership. Scope is resolved by the server. The current local implementation stores bytes only in in-memory synthetic storage.

post.summary: Complete and scan a scoped synthetic file upload
post.description: Requires the matching unconsumed upload intent, exact size and checksum, supported MIME magic, trusted content:write membership, and the same server-resolved scope.

200.description: Upload completed and synthetic scan state returned.

post.summary: Create a short-lived scoped file read link
post.description: Requires an approved file and trusted content:write membership. The link is bound to the same server-resolved tenant and campus scope.

get.summary: Read a file using a valid scoped link
get.description: Requires a valid unexpired read_token, an approved file, and trusted content:write membership in the scope that issued the link. Bytes are returned as Base64 from local in-memory synthetic storage.

200.description: Approved file bytes and safe metadata.

post.description: Requires a trusted identity with binding:apply. The server resolves tenant and campus scope and the applicant identity; client-selected scope or actor fields are not accepted.

get.summary: List the current guardian's relationship applications
get.description: Requires a trusted identity with binding:read. The server returns only applications owned by the current identity in its trusted scope.

200.description: Applications belonging to the current guardian.

get.summary: List the current guardian's approved relationships
get.description: Requires a trusted identity with binding:read. The server returns only relationships belonging to the current guardian in its trusted scope.

200.description: Approved relationships belonging to the current guardian.

post.description: Requires the current guardian's trusted binding:apply capability. The relationship must belong to that guardian in the trusted campus scope and the request must use the current version.

200.description: The relationship is released and its version is advanced.

get.summary: Read service health

post.summary: Sign in with an invited account
post.description: Accounts and their identity, campus memberships, and capabilities are configured by the server. Credentials are accepted only in the request body; clients cannot choose a role, tenant, or campus.

200.description: A short-lived bearer session was issued.

post.description: Requires the current bearer session. The server invalidates the token immediately; sending an expired or unknown token does not reveal account details.

get.summary: Read the current identity and active memberships
get.description: Identity comes from a trusted server-side authentication context. This contract does not define a client credential format.

get.summary: Read the current identity's active memberships
get.description: Identity comes from a trusted server-side authentication context. This contract does not define a client credential format.

200.description: Active memberships for the current identity.

get.summary: Read published public content in the active membership scope
get.description: Requires a trusted server-side identity and a matching tenant/campus membership. Client filters such as status, publication, version, or role are not accepted.

200.description: Published content visible in the active membership scope.

get.summary: Read published public institution or home content using server-owned scope
get.description: No visitor credential is required. The server resolves the tenant and optional campus scope. Client scope query fields do not select or broaden the returned content.

200.description: Published public institution or home content.

get.summary: List published activities for a date in the server-resolved campus scope
get.description: The server resolves campus scope from the configured public reference. The only accepted query parameters are a valid date and public_ref; client-supplied tenant, campus, identity, role, status, publication, or version filters are rejected. Only published public fields are returned.

200.description: Published activities active on the requested date.

get.summary: Read fee documents only for active approved guardian relationships
get.description: The server derives the one trusted campus. Fee documents and ledger rows are restricted to active guardian relationships for the authenticated actor. Query and scope override headers are rejected. This endpoint is read-only and never initiates payment or refund.

200.description: Synthetic fee view for the current approved children.

get.summary: List synthetic fee documents in one trusted current campus
get.description: Requires an explicitly granted fees:manage capability. The server rechecks the actor's active membership for the trusted campus. Client scope selectors are rejected.

200.description: Scoped synthetic fee records and active student choices.

post.summary: Create a scoped synthetic fee document
post.description: Creates a fee item, bill, or agreement in the trusted campus, adds a creation audit event, and records a synthetic charge only for positive amount fee items and bills. Agreement amounts must be null. This does not collect payment.

amount_minor.description: Integer CNY minor units; must be null for an agreement.

post.summary: Revoke one available synthetic fee document
post.description: Uses an expected version to prevent stale writes. The document is versioned and audited; append-only ledger history remains stored, while revoked fee details disappear from the parent view.

409.description: The fee document is already changed, revoked, or has a different version.

get.summary: List meals in the one trusted current campus
get.description: The server derives one unambiguous campus from trusted active memberships and rechecks database membership. Client identity and tenant/campus selectors are rejected. Internal scope and actor fields are never returned.

post.description: The UUID identifies the new meal, never its scope. Only the four menu payload fields are accepted; media, private notes and client scope/identity claims are rejected.

409.description: The identifier or version conflicts.

put.summary: Save a scoped meal draft with an expected version
put.description: Only DRAFT or UNPUBLISHED meals can be saved. Published meals must first be explicitly withdrawn with publication permission. The expected version is checked atomically; stale changes cannot replace newer data.

404.description: No meal in the trusted scope.

409.description: Stale version or conflicting state.

post.summary: Publish a scoped meal at its current version

403.description: Publication permission is required in an active campus.

404.description: No meal in the trusted scope.

409.description: Stale version or conflicting state.

post.summary: Withdraw a published scoped meal at its current version

403.description: Publication permission is required in an active campus.

404.description: No meal in the trusted scope.

409.description: Stale version or conflicting state.

get.summary: List published meals for a date in the server-resolved campus scope
get.description: The server resolves campus scope from the configured public reference. The only accepted query parameters are a valid date and public_ref; client-supplied tenant, campus, identity, role, status, publication, or version filters are rejected. Only published public fields are returned.

200.description: Published meals for the requested date.

get.summary: Read a published teacher profile in the server-resolved public scope
get.description: No client-supplied tenant, campus, role, status, publication, or version filter is accepted. The server resolves public scope. Only the published public field projection is returned.

get.summary: List pending guardian relationship applications in the active campus
get.description: Requires a trusted active staff membership with binding:review. Tenant and campus scope are resolved from the active membership; the client cannot choose another campus.

200.description: Pending applications in the active campus.

post.summary: Approve or reject a pending guardian relationship application
post.description: Requires a trusted active staff membership with binding:review in the application's campus. The review must use the current version; a stale version is rejected.

get.summary: Search published staff guides in the active campus
get.description: Requires an active membership with content:write. The server resolves campus scope from trusted membership; unsupported client scope, role, publication, ownership, and file filters are rejected.

get.summary: Read a published staff guide at an exact version
get.description: Requires an active membership with content:write. The server resolves campus scope from trusted membership and returns only the published version and safe file display reference.

get.summary: Search safe partner-link entry projections
get.description: Requires a trusted active staff membership with content:write. Scope is derived by the server. Results are synthetic local entry descriptions only; this endpoint does not contact or redirect to a partner service.

200.description: Published and enabled partner-link projections in the active campus.

get.summary: Issue a short-lived local entry handoff
get.description: Requires a trusted active staff membership with content:write and an enabled published entry in the server-resolved campus. Returns a synthetic handoff value only; no external partner is contacted and no redirect occurs.

200.description: A scoped synthetic entry handoff and its expiry.

get.summary: Search published staff resources in the active campus
get.description: Requires an active membership with content:write. The server resolves campus scope from trusted membership; unsupported client scope, role, publication, ownership, and file filters are rejected.

get.summary: Read a published staff resource at an exact version
get.description: Requires an active membership with content:write. The server resolves campus scope from trusted membership and returns only the published version and safe file access projection.

get.summary: List students in the employee's assigned classes
get.description: Requires attendance:write. Student and class scope come from trusted identity and active server-side class assignments.

get.summary: List attendance records in assigned classes
get.description: Requires attendance:write or attendance:review. Scope is resolved from trusted identity and active class assignments.

post.summary: Create an attendance record for an assigned student
post.description: Requires attendance:write. Tenant, campus, and class are resolved on the server.

409.description: A record already exists for the student and date.

get.summary: Read a staff attendance record

409.description: The state or version has changed.
The state or version has changed.

post.summary: Request a correction to an attendance record

409.description: A correction is already pending or the version changed.

post.summary: Approve or return an attendance correction

409.description: The correction or record version changed.

get.summary: List attendance summaries for active guardian relationships
get.description: Requires attendance:read. Only dates, arrival/departure status and times, correction status, and confirmed-leave indicator are returned.

get.summary: Read one attendance summary for an active guardian relationship
List leave requests for active guardian relationships
get.description: Requires leave:read. Only minimal request status and date summaries are returned; inactive relationships are excluded.

post.summary: Submit a leave request for an actively bound student
post.description: Requires leave:apply. Student relationship and organization scope are resolved by the server; caller-supplied tenant, campus, class, guardian, role, or membership identifiers are rejected.

409.description: The request overlaps another active request or its state could not be changed.
The request version or state is stale.

post.summary: Withdraw a submitted or returned leave request

409.description: The request version or state is stale.

post.summary: Acknowledge a confirmed or returned leave request

409.description: The request version or state is stale.

post.summary: Submit a manually reviewed learning summary
post.description: Stores a bounded aggregate for a student in the staff member's assigned class after active learning-support consent is checked.

get.summary: List submitted leave requests in assigned classes
get.description: Requires leave:review. Campus scope comes from trusted identity and class scope from active server-side class assignments.

post.summary: Confirm or return a leave request
post.description: Only the assigned class is eligible. Caller-supplied organization scope is never used.

409.description: The request version or state is stale.

post.description: The server derives institution or class scope from the selected fixed template and active staff assignments.

get.summary: List authored notices
get.description: Returns the authenticated staff member’s notices within the trusted campus and assigned classes.

get.summary: List notices available for staff action
get.description: Returns submitted notices in the trusted campus and assigned class scope, excluding the reviewer’s own submissions. Reviewers with notice:publish also see approved unpublished notices; reviewers with notice:revoke also see published notices. The server enforces each capability and scope.

200.description: Synthetic notices available for review, publication, or revocation according to the authenticated capabilities.

post.description: The author submits a draft or returned notice using its current version.
A different staff member with review permission approves or returns the current submitted version.
Publication is separate from review and only makes the fixed notice available to eligible parents; it sends no external message.
Revocation hides the notice from parent views and uses the current version.

get.summary: Read learning summaries for approved children
get.description: Returns only manually reviewed aggregate learning summaries for active approved guardian relationships.

200.description: The parent's current approved-child summary and controls.

get.summary: List fixed practice sessions for an approved child

200.description: The current guardian's fixed practice sessions.

post.summary: Start a bounded fixed-question practice session
post.description: Uses a fixed local exercise only. No free text, uploads, external AI provider, or unreviewed parent summary is created.

get.summary: Read one active-scope fixed practice session

post.summary: Show the next bounded fixed hint
Close an active fixed practice session

post.description: Stores controls for an active approved guardian relationship; summary access remains independent of the learning toggle.

post.summary: Record a local parent contact intention
post.description: Records an idempotent local intention only; it does not send a message.

201.description: The local contact intention was recorded.

get.summary: Read pickup authorizations and completed pickup records
get.description: Requires both binding:read and binding:apply. The server resolves the current guardian, active membership, campus, and approved relationships from trusted identity; client-selected scope is rejected.

200.description: Safe pickup projection for the current guardian.

post.description: Requires both binding:read and binding:apply. Identity, membership, tenant, campus, status, and version are server-owned. Only active approved guardian relationships may be used.

post.summary: Activate a saved pickup authorization draft
post.description: Requires both binding:read and binding:apply. The authorization must belong to the current guardian and use its current version.
Requires both binding:read and binding:apply. The authorization must belong to the current guardian and use its current version.

post.summary: Issue a short-lived pickup credential once
post.description: Requires both binding:read and binding:apply for the current guardian and its active campus. Returns the raw one-time value only in this response; the server stores only its SHA-256 digest and expires it within five minutes. Reissuing invalidates the previous unused credential.

200.description: A single-use pickup credential and its expiry.

get.summary: List published notices for an approved guardian
get.description: Returns notices in the authenticated campus that match at least one active, approved guardian relationship.

200.description: Published synthetic notices available to the guardian.

post.description: The active approved guardian relationship and current published notice version are checked on the server.
The parent must first mark the current published version as read.

get.summary: listAdminDailyReports
get.description: Trusted daily:review permission and active database membership, campus and assigned class are required. Own reports and drafts are excluded from the list. CONFIRM accepts SUBMITTED; RETURN accepts SUBMITTED or CONFIRMED; withdraw accepts only CONFIRMED. Stale versions and conflicting concurrent writes return 409. No client identity or scope parameters are accepted.

CONFIRM accepts SUBMITTED; RETURN accepts SUBMITTED or CONFIRMED; withdraw accepts only CONFIRMED. Stale versions and conflicting concurrent writes return 409. No client identity or scope parameters are accepted.

404.description: Report unavailable in scope or self-review denied.

409.description: Report version or state conflict.

get.summary: listInvitedStaffTasks
get.description: Uses one unambiguous trusted tenant/campus membership and current database class assignment. Staff read and act only on their own tasks. Management list additionally requires task:assign, task:check or task:cancel. No client-supplied identity/tenant/campus is accepted. Checks must be performed by another user. Assignment uses an explicit class and a current eligible server-provided choice. State/version transitions are atomic; returned/cancelled tasks retain the previous result. Dates are calendar dates without a fixed year range.

Preview the minimum information needed for pickup verification

get.summary: listStaffChildMonthlyReports
get.description: Trusted invited session capabilities are evaluated within the same active membership and campus scope; all required capabilities must belong to that membership. All query parameters and client identity or scope claims are rejected. Tenant and campus pairs are preserved and never combined across memberships. The database rechecks active user, tenant, campus, membership, assigned classes and student. Child sources contain only this student's growth and attendance records for the report month; internal staff daily records and other students' source details are excluded. Source changes invalidate prior approval and may hide a previously published report pending independent review. The list returns own reports unless the same scope permits review or publication; students lists only active assigned students in scopes with feedback:create. Reading may refresh source validity.

200.description: Child monthly report records within authorized assigned classes.

404.description: Student, report or approved guardian relationship is unavailable within the authorized scope, including self-review or self-publication denial.

409.description: Stale report, publication or relationship version, invalid state, duplicate child-month, source invalidation or concurrent write conflict.

post.description: Trusted invited session capabilities are evaluated within the same active membership and campus scope; all required capabilities must belong to that membership. All query parameters and client identity or scope claims are rejected. Tenant and campus pairs are preserved and never combined across memberships. The database rechecks active user, tenant, campus, membership, assigned classes and student. Child sources contain only this student's growth and attendance records for the report month; internal staff daily records and other students' source details are excluded. Source changes invalidate prior approval and may hide a previously published report pending independent review. The selected student must resolve uniquely within an authorized assigned class and campus. One report is allowed per child and month.

201.description: Child monthly report records within authorized assigned classes.

404.description: Student, report or approved guardian relationship is unavailable within the authorized scope, including self-review or self-publication denial.

Source changes invalidate prior approval and may hide a previously published report pending independent review. Only the creator may submit a draft with the current version and at least one current source.

200.description: Child monthly report records within authorized assigned classes.

404.description: Student, report or approved guardian relationship is unavailable within the authorized scope, including self-review or self-publication denial.

Multiple valid memberships and campuses are supported. The server resolves relationshipId only within the current actor's approved active guardian relationships and the complete trusted tenant/campus pairs. Duplicate or ambiguous trusted scope is forbidden (403); no matching relationship is not found (404). The relationship path identifies an object and never grants scope. Parent summaries omit class references, internal versions, staff actions, source IDs, review details and internal staff daily records.
